title: Attornato
tagline: Marketplace for tokenized boats. List, tokenize, request attestation, send binding orders and buy boats.
description:
Sellers can list their boat for sale. The boat gets tokenized.

Interested buyers can send an offer and request attestation. It works like a binding if the attestation was positive.

Surveyor inspects the boat, and if the condition of the boat matches the description, the order goes through.
how_its_made:
Frontend uses Wagmi/Viem and Dynamic. It serves 3 user types: sellers, buyers and surveyors. 

We use Chainlink to tokenize RWAs (boats). To attest the condition of the boat we want to use Sign protocol. Buyer funds are stored in an escrow contract during the attestation period.
